body.name: Off-model target-local block-constrained least-squares map
body.construction: Fix \(E\in\mathfrak S_p\), \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), and \(j\in V\). Write \(P_{Ej}=\operatorname{pa}_{G_E}(j)\), and let \(A_{Ej}\) have rows \(i\in P_{Ej}\), columns \(B\in\Pi^E_j\), and entries \((A_{Ej})_{iB}=\mathbf 1\{i\in B\}\). If \(P_{Ej}\neq\varnothing\), define \[\Gamma_{Ej}(\Sigma)=A_{Ej}^{\mathsf T}\Sigma_{P_{Ej},P_{Ej}}A_{Ej},\qquad h_{Ej}(\Sigma)=A_{Ej}^{\mathsf T}\Sigma_{P_{Ej},j},\qquad \beta_{Ej}(\Sigma)=\Gamma_{Ej}(\Sigma)^{-1}h_{Ej}(\Sigma).\] The columns of \(A_{Ej}\) are linearly independent because \(\Pi^E_j\) is a partition into nonempty blocks, so \(\Gamma_{Ej}(\Sigma)\) is positive definite and the solution is unique. Set \((L_E(\Sigma))_{ji}=\beta_{Ej,B}(\Sigma)\) for \(i\in B\in\Pi^E_j\) and zero for \(i\notin P_{Ej}\); if \(P_{Ej}=\varnothing\), take the unique empty coefficient vector and set row \(j\) to zero. Thus \(L_E(\Sigma)\) is defined for every \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), is rational in the entries of \(\Sigma\), and is smooth on the positive-definite cone.
